life_context: Lena keeps client event flyers and Instagram story layouts in Canva and often has one design open while she is on calls.
She wants Anticipy to help with tiny design-production edits, but only when it can prove it is looking at the same Canva file she has visible.
She is comfortable uploading a short written call note, but she does not want live microphone access to be required for a transcript-only task.
She will lose trust if Anticipy claims it changed a design from a log, a copied Chrome profile, or a generic browser note instead of the real Canva surface.
privacy_and_permissions: Normal public-product sign-in, onboarding, and installed user-device engine pairing are acceptable.
The installed user-device engine may read the visible Canva Chrome tab and normal screen/accessibility state when the product asks normally.
Lena expects Anticipy to ask or decline when Canva is not signed in, the file is not visible, or the requested area cannot be verified.
